title: Which country will host Xi Jinping’s first visit to the Middle East in 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official Chinese diplomatic announcements or contemporaneous reporting by major international news organizations, including Al Jazeera. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the first Middle Eastern country Xi Jinping visits in person during calendar year 2026. An announced visit does not count unless the travel occurs. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country’s common English name.
